purpose: Corroborate one exact artifact subject and digest without conflating same-runtime or same-identity channel agreement with an independent witness.
endpoint_requirements: Primary and witness identity references are independently authenticated.
Primary and witness channel identifiers are distinct.
Primary and witness runtime identifiers are distinct.
Primary and witness host identifiers are distinct.
Both endpoints bind the exact same subject and SHA-256 digest.
The witness endpoint has a durable evidence reference.

decision_states.VERIFIED: All endpoint distinctions, authentication, subject, digest, and evidence-reference checks pass.
decision_states.BLOCKED: A witness endpoint or required distinction/authentication evidence is unavailable.
decision_states.REFUSED: The endpoints returned different subject or digest values.

non_claims: A second API or URL in the same runtime is not by itself an independent witness.
The evaluator validates supplied evidence; it cannot authenticate an identity or create a witness observation.
A successful unit-test fixture does not establish a witness for repository state.

current_capability.reason: No independently authenticated identity, channel, runtime, and host endpoint is available for this task.
